title: keel CLI JSON envelope
description: The envelope every keel verb prints with --json, including keel api. It carries the exit code, the command-specific data (the same model the dashboard and MCP use) and diagnostics. $defs also define the keel api op names and the outbox drops a seat can write (O_EXCL files <seq>-<kind>.json in <workspace_root>/_runs/<RUN>/outbox/), which the Steward validates at ingest.

command.description: Verb and mode, for example 'check' or 'api ack'.

subject.description: What the command was about (an id, a path, file:line or a symbol), or null.

next.description: Legal next actions as copyable keel commands.

freshness.description: What the answer was computed from, or null for commands that compute no state.

exitCode.description: 0 ok, 1 gate failed, 2 usage, 3 needs a human, 4 claim conflict, 5 stale state or dirty checked-out trunk, 6 environment (including an agent-loaded signer key).

code.description: A check id (<gate>.<name>, common.schema.json#/$defs/checkId) or a refusal code.

hint.description: Success-shaped guidance, for example after a first ACK mismatch.

apiOp.description: keel api operations. Each writes only to the run outbox (context reads).

outboxDrop.description: One outbox drop, <seq>-<kind>.json with kind ack, ask, rule, result, verdict or triage. Ack, result and verdict payloads carry the same kind field; a planner triage record (triage.schema.json) has none, so its file name alone carries the kind; ask and rule drops wrap their payload. Hook-journal drops (<seq>-hook.json) are defined with the hook runner in M2.

askDrop.description: keel api ask: the question names the clause id it is about.

contextRequest.description: keel api context and the MCP keel_context tool: subject is required; seat and section may be null.

seat.description: The seat whose brief sections are returned, or null for the seat of the run bound by KEEL_RUN_ID. Without a bound run, seat is required in practice and a null seat is refused.

section.description: A single brief section, or null for the whole brief.
